entries.headline: Novavax joins public COVID-19 programme from October 19; CDC plans extra flu and Novavax doses
entries.zh: 115年度公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 提醒符合資格民眾儘早接種 還可獲得健康幣 另10月19日起新增提供不同製程之Novavax公費新冠疫苗
entries.why: Public programme (公費): a second COVID-19 brand enters the joint 左流右新 campaign tomorrow. Broad syndication of eligibility explainers frames Novavax as an option for people avoiding mRNA vaccines.
entries.headline_zh: Novavax 10月19日起納入公費COVID-19疫苗接種；疾管署規劃增購流感及Novavax疫苗
entries.why_zh: 公費：明日起第二個COVID-19疫苗廠牌加入「左流右新」聯合接種活動。接種資格說明文章廣泛轉載，將Novavax定位為不願接種mRNA疫苗者的選項。

entries.headline: Flu shots pass 3.15 million in half a month; CDC reportedly adds 500,000 doses
entries.why: Public programme (公費): outlets report flu uptake up about 15% and COVID-19 up about 40% year on year, with a reported urgent top-up of 500,000 flu doses. Tender volumes and allocation timing are now the live questions.
entries.headline_zh: 流感疫苗半個月接種逾315萬劑；據報疾管署追加50萬劑
entries.why_zh: 公費：媒體報導流感疫苗接種量年增約15%、COVID-19疫苗年增約40%，另據報緊急追加50萬劑流感疫苗。採購量與配送時程成為當前焦點。

entries.headline: Physicians link flu to stroke and cardiovascular risk in older adults, cite enhanced vaccines
entries.why: Funding is not stated in this coverage. Public enhanced doses go first to residents of long-term care, so this framing touches both the public programme and self-pay demand among other older adults. Enhanced-vaccine volume still fell week on week (25 vs 44).
entries.headline_zh: 醫師指流感與長者中風及心血管風險相關，提及加強型疫苗
entries.why_zh: 相關報導未說明經費來源。公費加強型疫苗優先提供長照機構住民，因此此論述同時涉及公費計畫與其他長者的自費需求。加強型疫苗聲量仍較前週下降（25對44）。

entries.headline: Local governments add Chongyang Festival and evening sessions as Taoyuan severe flu rises
entries.why: Public programme (公費): Hsinchu, Taoyuan, Pingtung and Taipei are expanding outreach to older adults and working parents. The CDC also flags clustering risk around election events.
entries.headline_zh: 桃園流感重症上升，地方政府加開重陽節及夜間接種場次
entries.why_zh: 公費：新竹、桃園、屏東及台北擴大針對長者與上班族家長的接種服務。疾管署亦提醒選舉活動期間的群聚風險。

entries.headline: Fact-checkers debunk recirculating retracted autopsy claim on COVID-19 vaccine deaths
entries.why: Not specific to either funding arena. The false claim resurfaces just as COVID-19 uptake rises and Novavax launches, while a separate article makes an unsupported "side effects halved" claim.
entries.headline_zh: 事實查核機構駁斥再度流傳、已撤稿的COVID-19疫苗死亡解剖說法
entries.why_zh: 不限於公費或自費市場。該不實說法正值COVID-19疫苗接種量上升及Novavax上市之際再度出現；另有一篇文章提出缺乏根據的「副作用減半」說法。

entries.headline: Thin social conversation: myocarditis data debate, Moderna origin question, personal shot posts
entries.why: Low-volume posts: one user cites myocarditis data in reply to a skeptic, another asks whether Moderna helped develop the virus. A personal post about receiving flu and COVID-19 shots drew the most engagement. Funding is not stated.
entries.headline_zh: 社群討論稀少：心肌炎數據爭論、Moderna起源疑問、個人接種分享
entries.why_zh: 貼文聲量低：一名用戶引用心肌炎數據回應質疑者，另一人質問Moderna是否參與開發病毒。一則分享接種流感及COVID-19疫苗的個人貼文互動最多。未說明經費來源。

watch.text: Delivery and allocation of the additional flu and Novavax doses the CDC said it plans, amid reports of a 500,000-dose flu top-up.
watch.text_zh: 疾管署所稱規劃增購之流感及Novavax疫苗的到貨與配送，另有報導指流感疫苗追加50萬劑。

qa.q: What exactly changes on October 19 for COVID-19 vaccination?
qa.a: Taiwan CDC adds the Novavax protein-based COVID-19 vaccine to the public programme from October 19 and says it plans additional Novavax doses. Media explainers focus on public-funded eligibility and frame it for people avoiding mRNA vaccines.
qa.a_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起將Novavax蛋白質次單位COVID-19疫苗納入公費計畫，並表示規劃增購Novavax疫苗。媒體說明文章聚焦公費接種資格，並將其定位為不願接種mRNA疫苗者的選擇。

qa.q: Is public flu supply under strain?
qa.a: Demand is running ahead of last year: about 3.15 million flu shots in half a month, reportedly up about 15%. One outlet reports the CDC urgently adding 500,000 doses, and the CDC said on October 13 that it plans more. No shortage reports appear in the last 72 hours of coverage.
qa.q_zh: 公費流感疫苗供應是否吃緊？
qa.a_zh: 需求高於去年：半個月接種約315萬劑，據報增加約15%。一家媒體報導疾管署緊急追加50萬劑，疾管署10月13日亦表示規劃增購。近72小時報導中未見缺貨消息。

qa.q: Is there anything new on RSV, Tdap or the self-pay market?
qa.a: Very little. RSV mentions rose week on week (29 vs 17) and Tdap was flat (6), but no RSV- or Tdap-specific story led coverage in the last 72 hours. Enhanced flu coverage does not specify public or self-pay access.
qa.q_zh: RSV、Tdap或自費市場有無新動態？
qa.a_zh: 極少。RSV聲量較前週上升（29對17），Tdap持平（6），但近72小時無RSV或Tdap相關主要報導。加強型流感疫苗報導未說明公費或自費。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: Establishes the official narrative of above-last-year public flu and COVID-19 uptake and a pre-holiday push for high-risk groups, setting the frame for later top-up orders.
policy_notes.why_zh: 確立官方論述：公費流感及COVID-19疫苗接種量高於去年，並於連假前推動高風險族群接種，為後續追加採購定調。

policy_notes.why: Formally adds Novavax to the public COVID-19 programme from October 19 and signals additional flu and Novavax procurement, the key supply and tender signal of the season so far.
policy_notes.why_zh: 正式自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗計畫，並釋出增購流感及Novavax疫苗訊號，為本季迄今最關鍵的供應與採購訊號。

misinfo.claim: A US autopsy study shows 74% of deaths were caused by COVID-19 vaccines
misinfo.note: The paper was retracted and fact-checkers have debunked it, but the video is recirculating during the campaign. Keep fact-check and regulator references ready for stakeholder queries.
misinfo.claim_zh: 美國解剖研究顯示74%死亡由COVID-19疫苗造成
misinfo.note_zh: 該論文已撤稿且經事實查核機構駁斥，但相關影片在接種期間再度流傳。應備妥事實查核及主管機關資料，以回應利害關係人詢問。

misinfo.claim: Next-generation COVID-19 vaccines have halved side effects
misinfo.note: This is an unsupported pro-vaccine claim. Avoid amplifying it, and keep any safety discussion anchored to approved labels and official data.
misinfo.claim_zh: 新一代COVID-19疫苗副作用減半
misinfo.note_zh: 此為缺乏根據的支持疫苗說法。避免擴散，任何安全性討論應以核准仿單及官方數據為依據。

misinfo.claim: Insinuation that Moderna helped develop the COVID-19 virus
misinfo.note: This is an isolated low-engagement post. Monitor for spread; no response is needed unless it gains traction.
misinfo.note_zh: 此為零星、低互動貼文。持續監測擴散情形；除非擴大發酵，否則無需回應。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Little product-specific signal this week: RSV mentions rose to 29 from 17, mostly social posts about multi-vaccine shot days, with no high-relevance news or official items on infant RSV antibodies.
products.implication: The infant RSV conversation is ticking up but is not yet tied to any policy decision or media story in the past 72 hours, so there is nothing new to react to.
products.action: Keep infant-RSV issue materials and stakeholder contacts current, and keep monitoring parent conversation for any care-centre cluster or access questions that could escalate.

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), enhanced flu, public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: Doctors quoted in several outlets link flu in older adults to stroke, disability and cardiovascular risk and mention adjuvanted or high-dose options, while enhanced-vaccine volume fell (hd 11 vs 15; enhanced 25 vs 44). Funding is not stated in these pieces, and Taiwan CDC's reported 500,000-dose flu top-up does not specify vaccine type.
products.implication: The enhanced-vaccine story now rests on clinician commentary rather than programme news, so questions may arise over whether top-ups or second-stage eligibility will include enhanced doses beyond long-term care residents.
products.action: Prepare an evidence and supply briefing for Taiwan CDC on the first enhanced-vaccine season, covering long-term care uptake and any top-up needs. Check that any clinician-facing activity stays scientific and non-promotional under Taiwan's prescription-medicine advertising rules.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），加強型流感疫苗，公費對象為65歲以上長照機構住民
products.signal_zh: 多家媒體引述醫師指出，長者感染流感與中風、失能及心血管風險相關，並提及佐劑型或高劑量疫苗；但加強型疫苗聲量下降（高劑量11對15；加強型25對44）。相關報導未說明經費來源，疾管署據報追加的50萬劑流感疫苗亦未說明疫苗類型。
products.implication_zh: 加強型疫苗議題目前仰賴臨床醫師評論而非計畫消息，可能引發追加採購或第二階段資格是否將加強型疫苗擴及長照機構住民以外對象的疑問。
products.action_zh: 為疾管署準備首個加強型疫苗接種季的實證與供應簡報，涵蓋長照機構接種情形及追加需求。確保任何針對臨床醫師的活動符合台灣處方藥廣告規範，維持科學性且不具宣傳性質。

products.sub_zh: 青少年及成人百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 訊號少：Tdap聲量持平於6則，唯一相關議題為先前醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗，近72小時無新進展。
products.implication_zh: Tdap未出現在當前流感及COVID-19接種新聞中，短期內無議題壓力。
products.action_zh: 維繫與提出慢性肺病患者接種議題之呼吸道相關醫學會的關係，並備妥百日咳議題資料，以因應可能出現的病例報導。
who_zh: 胸腔暨重症相關醫學會

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi, public programme from 19 October
products.signal: Taiwan CDC announced Novavax will be added to the public programme from 19 October and said it plans additional Novavax doses. Wide media pickup followed, focusing on its different manufacturing process and on who is eligible.
products.implication: Launch week puts Novavax in the spotlight, with likely scrutiny of site availability, eligibility rules and early safety reports, all against a backdrop of recirculating COVID-19 safety misinformation.
products.action: Run launch-week issue readiness. Align factual eligibility and supply information with Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus, prepare holding statements on distribution and adverse-event questions, and monitor fact-check outlets for claims attaching to the product.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單位疫苗，台灣由賽諾菲代理，10月19日起納入公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署宣布Novavax自10月19日起納入公費計畫，並表示規劃增購Novavax疫苗。媒體廣泛報導，聚焦其不同製程及接種資格。
products.implication_zh: 開打首週Novavax成為焦點，接種點供應、資格規定及早期安全性通報可能受到檢視，且背景為COVID-19安全性不實資訊再度流傳。
products.action_zh: 做好開打首週議題準備。與疾管署及地方衛生局對齊接種資格及供應的事實資訊，備妥配送及不良事件問題的回應聲明，並監測事實查核機構是否出現涉及本產品的說法。

issues.title: Novavax public COVID-19 rollout first week
issues.note: Coverage is heavy on eligibility; expect questions on which sites stock it, early uptake figures and any adverse-event posts, and on the additional Novavax doses Taiwan CDC said it plans.
issues.note_zh: 報導多聚焦接種資格；預期將出現哪些接種點有供應、早期接種數據及不良事件貼文等問題，以及疾管署所稱規劃增購之Novavax疫苗。

issues.title: Second-stage public flu eligibility amid top-up orders
issues.note: With flu vaccinations reported between 2.26 and 3.15 million and a reported 500,000-dose top-up, scrutiny of supply adequacy and of the enhanced versus standard mix may intensify as more groups become eligible.
issues.title_zh: 追加採購下的第二階段公費流感疫苗接種資格
issues.note_zh: 流感疫苗接種量據報介於226萬至315萬劑，另據報追加50萬劑，隨著更多族群符合資格，對供應是否充足及加強型與標準型疫苗配比的檢視可能升溫。

issues.title: COVID-19 safety misinformation recirculating during campaign
issues.note: A debunked autopsy claim is circulating again, and an article claimed side effects of next-generation COVID-19 vaccines were halved. Either could attach to the new rollout, so keep fact-based responses ready with official sources.
issues.title_zh: 接種期間COVID-19安全性不實資訊再度流傳
issues.note_zh: 已遭駁斥的解剖說法再度流傳，另有文章宣稱新一代COVID-19疫苗副作用減半。兩者皆可能連結到新疫苗開打，應備妥以官方資料為據的事實回應。

self_pay.title: Little direct self-pay signal this week
self_pay.note: Nothing in the past 72 hours covers clinic stock, prices or promotion in the self-pay market for enhanced flu vaccines, RSV infant antibodies or Tdap. Almost all coverage concerns the public programme.
self_pay.title_zh: 本週自費市場直接訊號少
self_pay.note_zh: 近72小時無關於加強型流感疫苗、嬰幼兒RSV抗體或Tdap自費市場之診所庫存、價格或推廣的報導。幾乎所有報導皆聚焦公費計畫。

self_pay.title: Enhanced-flu commentary with funding unstated
self_pay.note: Doctor-led pieces urging older adults to consider adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines do not say whether these are publicly funded or self-paid. Watch whether older adults outside the first-priority long-term care group begin asking clinics about self-pay access.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型流感疫苗評論未說明經費來源
self_pay.note_zh: 醫師主導、呼籲長者考慮佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗的報導，未說明為公費或自費。留意第一優先長照機構對象以外的長者是否開始向診所詢問自費接種。
